“Nine Realms,” the six-armed silhouette spoke directly, “His Majesty has reached the Nine Realms in his mastery of the Spacetime Rule, just one step away from comprehending the Great Dao of Spacetime.”

“The Great Dao of Spacetime?”

Lin Yuan’s expression became slightly somber.

An eleventh-rank life trying to reach the ultimate, if successful, would break free from the shackles of the River of Time and would soon comprehend the Great Dao that was closest to one’s self.

For example, the Space Great Dao, Life Great Tao, Death Great Dao, Void Realm Great Dao?

...

Among the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization, the Void God Supreme Being comprehended the Space Great Dao.

The Great Dao towers above all rules and is the fundamental basis for a Supreme Being’s enlightenment.

Normally, Supreme Beings would transform a certain pillar rule into their own Great Dao.

As for the pillar Fusion Rules and the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, transforming them into a Great Dao requires at least a Twelfth Stage powerhouse who has survived through a Cosmic Era.

“Unfortunately, a single step’s difference is like that between heaven and earth,”

the six-armed silhouette shook its head, “If His Majesty could master the Great Dao of Spacetime, perhaps he would not have disappeared.”

“Perhaps His Majesty Xuan Huang has not died at all,”

Lin Yuan consoled.

Since His Majesty Xuan Huang’s disappearance, with one Cosmic Era after another passing, the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path had not given birth to an ultimate being.

The reason could well be related to the disappearance of His Majesty Xuan Huang.

Of course, whether an Evolution Path has an ultimate existence can be verified in other ways. Currently, the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path truly has no ultimate life standing at its end.

But beings of His Majesty Xuan Huang’s caliber, who knows whether they might have ways to avoid this fact.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s form appeared.

“You should also cultivate the ‘Xuan Huang Physique’ to the tenth rank perfection.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Taiyang Divine Spirit; the stronger the essence of life of the two Primordial Spirits, the more Origin Source they could bear when the Chaos Void Origin infuses them in the future.

Hu!

The Taiyang Divine Spirit immediately entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Right when the True Body entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm for cultivation, Lin Yuan had purchased another batch of resources for the Taiyang Divine Spirit to cultivate the “Xuan Huang Physique.”

…

“Having comprehended the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule for so long, it is time to visit the Demon Jade Space and see if I can break through the sixth layer,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

To pass the fifth layer of the Demon Jade Space, one must thoroughly comprehend the Rule of Time, which Lin Yuan achieved as early as when he was Ninth Rank.

However, the sixth layer requires the comprehension of the Time-Space Fusion Rule, and with Lin Yuan already in the Dual Realm of Time-Space Fusion Rules, he could certainly attempt it.

“I should also finalize the rewards for passing the fifth layer,”

Lin Yuan had already decided; the reward list for the fifth layer consisted of treasures or heritages of the Twelve-Star Level. Previously, he had been unsure of what to choose, but now he had an idea.

Weng.

The next moment.

A sliver of Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will, following the Magic Jade Mark, descended upon the Demon Jade Space.

“The Demon Jade Space is not located within the Main Universe but is in the Chaos Void,” Lin Yuan observed his surroundings and felt differently.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm relied on the Main Universe, so Lin Yuan could enter it in body with just a thought.

The Demon Jade Space, on the other hand, located God knows how far from the Main Universe, was a place Lin Yuan could at most arrive at with a single thought.

Even so, the fact was quite astonishing; the prowess of the Moyu Tower Master in the aspect of Space Great Dao was absolutely beyond calculation.

His Majesty Xuan Huang.

The Demonic Jade Tower Master.

Powerhouses from different epochs.

Yet, their outcomes were quite similar.

Both disappeared suddenly.

Before long,

Lin Yuan arrived in front of the imposing Nine Floors Dark Tower.

The Stone Statue Shen Ji had been waiting for a long time.

The moment Lin Yuan descended into the Demon Jade Space, he was aware of it.

“Have you reached the tenth rank?”

Stone Statue Shen Ji scrutinized Lin Yuan carefully, feeling inexplicably sentimental.

From when Lin Yuan was Seventh Rank and became an ordinary member of the Moyu Tower, to now being Tenth Rank.

He had witnessed Lin Yuan’s progress every step of the way.

Watching as Lin Yuan broke many of the Moyu Tower’s records.

“Are you planning to choose your rewards, or…?”

Stone Statue Shen Ji looked at Lin Yuan and asked in a low voice.

To date, Lin Yuan still had two opportunities to choose rewards, all held by him.

One was from when he first passed the second floor of the Dark Tower, and the other was the reward from passing the fifth floor of the Dark Tower.

Besides choosing rewards,

Lin Yuan’s descent into the Demon Jade Space could also mean he intends to continue challenging the tower.

But now that Lin Yuan had already passed the fifth floor of the Dark Tower, if he were to continue, it would only be the sixth floor.

The sixth floor of the Dark Tower requires at least the comprehension of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule to pass, while the seventh floor is the realm of ultimate beings.

“Let’s start with the seventh floor,”

Lin Yuan spoke.

The matter of selecting rewards could wait.

If possible, he intended to choose the rewards for the fifth and sixth floors together.

“The seventh floor?”

Stone Statue Shen Ji fell into a brief silence.

Based on his experience, Lin Yuan had not descended into the Demon Jade Space for over a hundred years.

Now, with his arrival, he planned to challenge the sixth floor.

The only possibility is that he has great confidence.

“Have you comprehended the Time-Space Fusion Rule?”

Stone Statue Shen Ji couldn’t help but ask.

If he hadn’t witnessed Lin Yuan creating many miracles and records,

he would never have asked the question.

Comprehending the Time-Space Fusion Rule at the tenth rank?

Is that some kind of joke?

Yet the Stone Statue was seriously inquiring.

Because it was indeed possible for Lin Yuan to achieve it.

“Almost,”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“Really comprehended it?”

Stone Statue Shen Ji’s thoughts were complex.

But he immediately believed it.

Lin Yuan had no reason to lie.

“Go ahead then,”

Stone Statue Shen Ji stepped aside and opened the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

Hualala.

Lin Yuan entered the Dark Tower.

Stone Statue Shen Ji watched quietly.
